data.name: True Christ
data.detailed_description:
Step into the life of Jesus like never before in True Christ, a unique simulation-adventure game that lets you experience the journey, challenges, and miracles of Christ in an immersive and family-friendly way. Explore detailed, historically inspired environments where every decision matters, manage essential resources like hunger, stamina, and health, and use simple tools to survive and interact with the world around you.

True Christ combines faith-based storytelling with engaging gameplay mechanics, offering a meaningful experience for players of all ages. Witness key moments from Jesus’ life, from humble beginnings to performing miracles, and feel the spiritual journey as you navigate challenges, care for your health, and use your skills to guide others along the path of compassion and faith.

Key Features:

  • Simulation and Resource Management: Monitor hunger, stamina, and health while interacting with your environment. Use simple tools to gather, build, and assist others, giving players a realistic sense of daily life in biblical times.

  • Faith-Based Adventure: Explore towns, countryside, and holy sites, experiencing the life of Christ in a respectful and inspiring way. Learn lessons of compassion, humility, and courage through immersive storytelling.

  • Interactive Environments: Collect items, use tools, and interact with NPCs to complete tasks and witness miracles unfold. Every action has a purpose in the journey of faith.

  • Family-Friendly Gameplay: Designed for players of all ages, with no explicit content, making it suitable for children, teens, and adults who want meaningful entertainment.

  • Cultural and Historical Accuracy: Experience environments, clothing, and traditions inspired by historical biblical accounts, providing an educational and immersive experience.

  • Spiritual Growth and Reflection: Beyond gameplay, True Christ encourages reflection on moral choices, kindness, and service, offering a unique blend of entertainment and spiritual enrichment.

Whether you are a Christian looking for an engaging way to explore the life of Jesus, or a player interested in story-driven simulation adventures, True Christ offers an unforgettable journey. Immerse yourself in faith, adventure, and historical storytelling. Experience the teachings of Jesus, live the miracles, and discover the lessons that have inspired millions around the world.

Join a meaningful adventure that combines simulation, exploration, and narrative. True Christ is more than a game—it is a spiritual journey where every choice, every action, and every moment matters. Perfect for families, educators, and anyone seeking a thoughtful and inspiring experience in gaming.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 o equivalente
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon 555
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
